description: Talent trees: 3 branches x 5 tiers per class. tools/talent_spec.py generated the first version; edit here from now on. Engine: scripts/resources/TalentManager.gd.

fields.name: tier_points
fields.help: Points that must be spent in a branch before each tier opens, e.g. [0, 2, 4, 6, 8].

fields.name: respec_gold_per_level
fields.help: Respec cost in copper = this x level.

fields.name: loadout_size
fields.help: Skills a character can take into battle.

fields.name: skill
fields.help: This node unlocks an active skill (then 'effects' is usually empty).

fields.name: effects
fields.help: List of effects per rank, e.g. [{"type": "stats", "stats": {"toughness": 3}}, {"type": "damage", "mult": 0.05, "with": "two_handed"}]. Types: stats, damage, defense, heal_bonus, lifesteal, skill, combo, status_chance, regen. See TalentManager.gd.
